answer: Deposits are visible in jetty, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 87 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. A farm of 4764 identities would post 3829 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
